lines.text: The clans of Judah include Perez, Hezron, and Hur, and Ashhur the father of Tekoa has two wives.
Jabez, more honorable than his brothers, calls out to the God of Egypt to bless him and enlarge his territory.
Shimei of Simeon has sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers have few children, so the clan stays smaller than Judah.
In the days of Hezekiah, Simeonites go to Gedor seeking water, attack the Hamites and Meunites, and settle there.

wrong_details.true: in search of pasture for their flocks

lines.text: Five hundred Simeonites go to Mount Seir, strike down the remnant of the Amalekites, and live there to this day.
